description: This file defines configuration classes for setting up SQS streaming in Orleans, including configurators for silos and cluster clients with options for SQS, caching, and partitioning.

classes.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up SQS streaming in an Orleans silo, allowing configuration of SQS options, cache, and partitioning.

classes.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up SQS streaming in an Orleans cluster client, providing options for SQS and partitioning.

methods.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator() (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the silo stream configurator with specific service configurations for logging and options.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Configures SQS options for the silo stream.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures cache size for the stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures partitioning options for the stream.

methods.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator() (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the cluster client stream configurator with service logging options.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Configures SQS options for the cluster client stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures partitioning options for the cluster client stream.
